title: Application Logging Logrotate Entity
description: Logrotate-specific configuration. Extends Application/Logging with logrotate-specific settings.

rotate.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

path.description: Log file path or glob pattern (e.g., "/var/log/nginx/*.log").

rotate.description: Number of rotated files to keep for this path.

missingok.description: Do not error if the log file is missing.

notifempty.description: Do not rotate if the log file is empty.

create.description: Create new log file after rotation.

postrotate.description: Script to run after rotation (e.g., "systemctl reload nginx").
